# paddle_transactions (Data Source)

List every Paddle transaction matching `subscription_id`/`customer_id`/`status` filters — the plural companion to `paddle_transaction` (which requires exactly one match). Leave all filters unset to list every transaction in the account. Deliberately excludes `line_items` — unlike the singular data source, which re-fetches each match by ID to get it, doing that for every result here would be an N+1 API call per match; look up a transaction's `id` here, then feed it into `paddle_transaction` (singular) to get `line_items` for `paddle_adjustment`. See [Paddle API Reference](https://developer.paddle.com/api-reference/transactions/overview).

**⚠️ An unfiltered (or loosely filtered) call to this data source lists every matching transaction in the account, one API call per page of results — a real cost against a large account, and a large `transactions` list written into your Terraform state file on every `plan`/`refresh`.** Narrow with `subscription_id`/`customer_id`/`status` where practical.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "paddle_transactions" "example" {
  # Filter by owning subscription
  subscription_id = "sub_..." # replace with a real subscription ID

  # Optionally narrow further:
  # customer_id = "ctm_..."
  # status      = "paid"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `customer_id` (String) Filter by the owning customer's ID (prefix `ctm_...`). Leave unset to match transactions for any customer.
- `status` (String) Filter by status. Leave unset to match any status.
- `subscription_id` (String) Filter by the owning subscription's ID (prefix `sub_...`). Leave unset to match transactions for any subscription.

### Read-Only

- `transactions` (Attributes List) Matching transactions (without `line_items` — see above). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--transactions))

<a id="nestedatt--transactions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `transactions`

Read-Only:

- `customer_id` (String) Paddle customer ID (prefix `ctm_...`) owning this transaction.
- `id` (String) Paddle transaction ID (prefix `txn_...`).
- `origin` (String) How this transaction was created (e.g., `subscription_charge`, `subscription_recurring`, `web`, `api`).
- `status` (String) One of `draft`, `ready`, `billed`, `paid`, `completed`, `canceled`, `past_due`.
- `subscription_id` (String) Paddle subscription ID (prefix `sub_...`) owning this transaction.
